premises.text: E-commerce search makes shopping solitary and chore-like by assuming needs are known
premises.evidence_span: The ever-present search metaphor presumes that we only want what we know. And thus the experience has become very solitary, almost like a chore

premises.text: Visual mall-like proof of people viewing products plus friend peek signals drives discovery
premises.evidence_span: This visual proof of people looking at products, just like the hustle and bustle of a mall, gives us a sense of popularity of the products

premises.text: Personalized daily store curated from aspirational brands and friend likes
premises.evidence_span: We use what you and your friends like on Sneak Peek to create a store every single day just for you

premises.text: Peek mechanic reveals and drops price with limited peeks and time pressure
premises.evidence_span: On Sneak Peek, peek is like flipping over the price tag. It only gets better, though, because every peek drops the price for everyone peeking

premises.text: Friend social proof and advice convert discovery into purchase
premises.evidence_span: having social or friends data in it really helps people move from discovery to the purchase phase

premises.text: Distribution across site, Facebook, and tablets
premises.evidence_span: It works inside the comforts of Facebook, so you never have to leave Facebook to use Sneak Peek

premises.text: Brand partnerships monetize via impulse sales and social engagement
premises.evidence_span: we help them deliver meaningful sales, which are mostly impulse, and we help them deliver meaningful engagement on social channels

value.text: Friend-influenced discovery shopping that replaces solitary e-commerce search
value.evidence_span: friends do help friends discover products

notes: Merged game mechanics into peek pricing premise. Two-domain partition.
